opportunity_detection.principle: Evidence convergence remains more important than keyword volume.

context_verification.principle: Verify the primary source before autonomous action.

action_selection.principle: Prefer concrete delegated work with a useful deliverable.

response_learning.principle: Use observed outcomes without treating silence as failure.

payment_evidence.principle: Declared payment is not verified settlement.

proposed_changes.change: Maintain current strategy while collecting additional outcome evidence.

rejected_changes: Do not lower opportunity priority solely because an action received no response.
Do not increase opportunity priority solely because a post contains payment language.
Do not convert a single observed outcome into a permanent detection rule.
Do not replace primary-source evidence with local memory summaries.
Do not automatically deploy a new detection or action rule.

principles: Observed outcomes can influence future priorities.
One outcome is evidence, not a permanent rule.
No response is not equivalent to failure.
Positive response is not automatically proof of economic value.
Primary-source verification remains mandatory before consequential decisions.

next_stage.purpose: Test adaptive strategy signals against new live opportunity data before allowing stronger autonomous prioritization.
